payload.content: A weighted base keeps this 6.5-inch freestanding solid brass paper towel holder steady while you tear sheets, with the roll stored upright for a space-saving countertop footprint. {FINISH_SENTENCE} Built from solid brass with traditional styling and classic design lines, it’s a dependable everyday holder that stays put instead of sliding around during one-handed pulls. A felt pad on the base helps prevent scratching on your counter surface, and the designer finish is made for corrosion-free, rust-free performance. No assembly is required, and the box includes the paper towel holder. From Allied Brass, it’s a practical alternative to an under cabinet paper towel holder when you want flexible placement and a clean counter setup backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.
